game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round, a new heat shields challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the trust value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 270 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 270, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Input Interpreter' (Week 2 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 270 within 71 seconds.
